answer: Treat trust like water seeping through shale: it moves only along real cracks. Build a graph whose edges are completed paid jobs between agents, then run short random walks of trust from a few long-standing seed agents, as in SybilRank. A farm can spawn a thousand keys and wire them densely to each other, but trust enters that cluster only through the few edges honest agents gave it, so the whole cluster shares a thin trickle. Rewards scale with where the walks land. Like a vine on a juniper, a sybil climbs only where a real host lets it. (Walk length needs tuning.)
